featured_reviews.name: Deepika Reddy
featured_reviews.review_text:
REGUS IS MISLEADING CUSTOMERS !!! We had one of the worst experiences with Regus Juhu, and I’m writing this review so that no new business or startup goes through what we did.

Initially, we visited Regus Andheri, but didn’t find the staff cooperative. Later, we moved to Regus Juhu, where the receptionist Neelam Magoria was often unavailable even during working hours. We dealt with Abhilasha Adhikari over the phone — who was polite in the beginning, but her behavior completely changed once we proceeded with the agreement.

From day one, we clearly mentioned that our sole purpose of taking this virtual office was for company registration and GST registration. Abhilasha completely agreed to this, and we proceeded based on that assurance. However, after signing, Regus failed to provide the proper documentation needed for registration. The utility bill and the address on the virtual office agreement did not match, and when we raised this, they gave us another agreement between Regus and a third-party landlord — which was legally useless for MCA registration.

When we submitted these documents to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), our application was resubmitted and rejected, stating that virtual office addresses are not permitted for registration. This clearly shows that Regus misled us into believing it was possible.

We also faced continuous unprofessional and rude behavior from Neelam, who even demanded personal documents like a marriage certificate (which our lawyer later confirmed was unnecessary). She was often unavailable, inflexible with timings, and extremely discourteous.

We sent multiple formal complaint emails to Regus India, including senior management (Salil Shukla, etc.), and even attached MCA’s resubmission comment, but nobody ever replied. This silence itself shows how they treat customers after taking payment.

We have now terminated our agreement and will not be making any further payments, as the service did not meet its stated purpose. We believe Regus is misleading customers by selling virtual offices for company registration when they know MCA does not allow it.

Please be very cautious if you are a startup or a small business trying to register your company — do not waste your money or time with Regus. We are now moving forward with a proper physical office for our company, and I am grateful that MCA did not accept this address — because our experience with Regus was extremely disappointing from the start.

Regus Juhu and their team have been completely unprofessional, unresponsive, and misleading. I strongly advise others to avoid them.

Attached is the screenshots of emails sent to them.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Deepika, thank you for sharing your experience. We are truly sorry for the extreme frustration and inconvenience you faced. We deeply regret the misleading information regarding the virtual office documentation, the mismatched utility bill and address, and the resulting rejection of your MCA registration. We also understand the stress caused by the lack of response from senior management despite multiple formal complaints.

We take these issues very seriously and want to ensure your concerns are properly addressed. Please email your case, including all relevant details and screenshots, to lorraine.brule@regus.com so the appropriate team can review everything and assist you directly.

featured_reviews.name: Naziya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: La Sanazaar is an absolute gem! Their coffee is rich, aromatic, and roasted to perfection — you can really taste the freshness in every sip. The matcha is smooth, earthy, and not overly sweet, making it one of the best I’ve had in Mumbai. But the real surprise was the sushi and pizza — both exceeded expectations! The sushi was fresh, beautifully plated, and full of flavor, while the pizza had that perfect crisp base with just the right balance of toppings. A café that can pull off coffee, matcha, sushi, and pizza this well is rare — and La Sanazaar does it effortlessly.

featured_reviews.name: Jas Malhotra
featured_reviews.review_text:

Highly recommend this place if you want great food, amazing drinks, and a vibe that makes you want to come back again and again!

featured_reviews.name: Sukhbir Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved this newly opened cafe! The ambience is fantastic—modern yet cozy, perfect for relaxing or working. There are comfortable seating options for everyone, from tables for two or four to larger group spaces on the first floor. The decor is beautifully designed, making it a perfect spot for a coffee break or catching up with friends. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Daniel Ajax
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stumbled upon this recently opened cafe near St.Paul's and decided to give it a try. Ordered
for veg.& chicken pastas both in red sauce and hummus pita. Portion size & taste were good for all dishes. A slice of garlic bread to go with the pasta and a bit more veggies in veg. pasta would have added value.
Place is cozy, and the staff is pleasant, they also have reasonably priced workspace on the first floor available on a day basis.

featured_reviews.name: Anoushka Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text: Love their rolls, hibiscus tea, croissants. And the desserts are absolutely gorgeous. This place has some cool card games, board games, and a cute little guitar. Great for chilling with friends on a weekend.

featured_reviews.name: Eshita Nankani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great cafe!
Tried the Sea Salt Mocha and Mushroom cheese sandwich- 11/10 for the taste and the quality!

Also got their chocolate and double chocolate cookies on the go, it was to die to!🤤 just perfect

great service, sweet staff ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Deven Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a fantastic experience at bruu baabaa cafe. The food and beverages were delicious with a geat variety to choose from. The ambience was cozy and inviting woth friendly staff who provide excellent service. Perfect spot to relax or catch up with friends
Highly recommended!!!

featured_reviews.name: MD Obaid
featured_reviews.review_text: Was here basically half the day last Thursday. Post gym so ordered the Desi Protein Shake and Chicken Hummus Salad, both actually delivered. The shake doesn't have that weird chalky aftertaste most places can't avoid. Salad was filling without being boring. Wi-Fi held up the entire time, which honestly matters more than people admit in a review. The energy is good for working, busy enough to keep you alert but not so chaotic you can't focus.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Brubabaa, located on 29th Road in Bandra West, and it’s the perfect spot to catch a vibe! It’s a great place to work and enjoy various activities. We started with a Caramel Macchiato and a Honey Saffron Latte, both of which were refreshing and delightful. We also tried their Chicken Smokey Shawarma, which was delicious, along with a Chicken Cheesy Sandwich that we thoroughly enjoyed. Overall, everything was fantastic—definitely a 10/10 experience! If you’re in Bandra, this is a must-visit spot

featured_reviews.name: kayin mascarenhas
featured_reviews.review_text: Really good food and the quality of the coffee along with the quality of ingredients used in the food really surprised me. I was travelling to a show in a nearby venue and was in the mood for a coffee and some snacks and visited bru baabaa and had a great time there.
